Hi Suzanna,
Thank you for these kind words! We loved seeing you and Fred on Saturday. He's such a handsome man!
Warmly,
Juli
Practice Manager
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating D S! We're thrilled you and your pet had a great experience at BLVD Vet River North. Our team truly appreciates the support, see you at the next visit!

If I could give zero stars, I would. We trusted Boulevard Vet to help us as new parents to our 8 month old, 8 pound puppy. He had non-stop, bloody diarrhea on 7/10/2026. We took him to the River North location - where we have been patients since 1/2026 - for help. He got sick again on their office floor. They sent us home without giving him fluids, with a probiotic that would take "several days to kick in" and told us that he was underweight (after months of telling us to reduce his food and watch his weight). They also asked us where he had been neutered and where we heard to reduce his food - all of which was told to us by the vets at Boulevard.

He continued to deteriorate for the next 2 hours and started violently shaking and yelping when I tried to pick him up. I rushed him to the emergency vet, where they were very concerned and admitted him for 2 nights (7/10/2026 - 7/12/2026). Had I listened to the recommendation from Boulevard Vet, who knows what would have happened to our little guy. When I called to tell them what had happened and how upset we were, they claimed they did nothing wrong and that "hopefully he would recover" - completely lacking empathy. They also would not reimburse us for a $300 visit (where they did nothing to help our puppy), just solidifying that they do not care about the wellbeing of pets or parents. If you love your pet, DO NOT go to any locations of Boulevard Vet in Chicago.

If you have unlimited money and don’t care whether your pet receives timely medical care, BLVD Vet might be the perfect place for you.

I’ve been a BLVD customer for more than six years and have brought two dogs there. I’ve spent thousands of dollars with this practice, which makes this experience even more frustrating.

On May 29, my 4-year-old poodle saw Dr. Nick Spano for her annual exam. She was ultimately healthy. The bill was almost $700 for a routine annual visit.

During that appointment, I was told her ALT levels were elevated and that I should consider additional testing or an ultrasound, ranging from about $160 to more than $800.

Two weeks later, my dog developed severe vomiting and diarrhea. I called BLVD the next morning during normal business hours because I wanted her seen by her actual veterinarian.

Their advice? Go to the ER.

Not after hours. Not on a weekend. On a Wednesday morning.

My primary vet, the one I pay premium prices for, couldn’t see a sick patient and sent me straight to an emergency hospital.

Over the next few days, I spent more than $3,000 at the ER vet.

As my dog’s condition continued, I called BLVD again and asked about Metronidazole based on recommendations from friends, including veterinarians. I couldn’t speak with a veterinarian. I couldn’t speak with a vet tech. I could only speak with someone who schedules appointments.

I was told they were “concerned,” but apparently not concerned enough for an actual medical professional to call me.

My call was around 10:30 a.m. The return call came at 1:03 p.m. Not from a doctor. Not from a tech. Another voicemail from the front desk telling me they couldn’t help and to go back to the ER.

Again, this was diarrhea. Not a complex surgical issue. Diarrhea.

By Friday, BLVD had been so unhelpful that I went back to the ER. The ER vet prescribed Metronidazole without all the runaround.

Since BLVD had already raised concerns about her elevated ALT, I also went ahead with the ultrasound. The result? No liver abnormalities, no pancreatic abnormalities, and no obstruction. Nothing concerning.

Less than 12 hours after one dose of Metronidazole, my dog had normal stool and was acting completely like herself again.

To be fair, BLVD’s facilities are beautiful. If you want a spa-like experience for your dog, you’ll probably be impressed.

But if you want accessible veterinary care when your pet is actually sick, the ability to speak with someone medically trained, and recommendations that feel practical rather than expensive, I’d strongly suggest going elsewhere.

I’m sure BLVD’s response will mention “evidence-based medicine.” What I experienced was a $700 wellness visit, costly diagnostic recommendations, repeated ER referrals during normal business hours, no access to a veterinarian or vet tech when my dog was sick, and more than $3,000 in ER bills.

You can decide for yourself whether that sounds like good veterinary care.

Friendly staff but ask for line item pricing upfront. I paid 58 dollars for a nail trim. This was more than double what I had paid in the past so when questioned, they charged 29 dollars for a nail trim and an additional 29 dollars for a tech visit and said they charge the additional fee because their equipment is “medical” and they are not groomers. Seems shady as hell and I’ve never been charged an additional fee anywhere else in the US. Very disappointing since their staff is awesome. I won’t be returning

We had a wonderful experience bringing our pup to the BLVD River North location! We recently decided to change vets and have been to other vets in the area and this experience felt like night and day.

We brought our Mini Doxie in for his first appointment with Dr. Courville and we couldn't have left feeling any better than we did. Both Dr. Courville and the vet tech, Jorge, did a great job answering questions we had and walking us through their recommended treatment for some GI issues. The front desk staff is extremely helpful too. In addition, after our appointment we received detail responses from Dr. Courville around our dog's bloodwork and test results - more than we have from the other veterinary offices we've visited.

Prices are aligned with other vets in the area, so we knew what to expect there. The recommended treatment was offered with realistic encouragement, where as other clinics we've been to in the area have pushed us for hefty treatment, with a feeling they were trying to 'sell it' to us - can happily say, BLVD did not do this and was agreeable to our gradual assessment of treatment.

Overall, would highly recommend BLVD Vet to anyone looking for a Vet group that really goes above and beyond - Dr. Courville was wonderful as well!

We truly appreciate your positive rating! Thank you for trusting us with your pet’s care, we’re so glad to have you in our vet clinic. 

Warmly,
Juli
Practice Manager

We transitioned our dog Charlie to BLVD River North about a year ago. The staff there was always friendly and took care of him, but what really blew me away was recently when Charlie became sick and had thrown up several times one morning. BLVD had an urgent appt slot available with Dr. Spano. Dr. Spano and his team, specifically the vet tech Daisy, were really great with Charlie, and gave us several options for treatment and were upfront about pricing, detailing what they felt he absolutely needed and what we could decide on based on our comfort level. But what really impressed me was that Charlie was due to return for a repeat x-ray the following morning, yet overnight he threw up again prompting us to rush him to an emergency vet. Dr. Spano noticed Charlie was off the schedule that morning and immediately called us to ask if he was okay. We really appreciated that phone call and that extra care Dr. Spano took to make sure Charlie was alright. The receptionist team was also really great about sending me a detailed email shortly afterwards when I inquired about transitioning his food to something new after that episode, which was truly appreciated.

We have two young huskies and BLVD has been phenomenal with them. Our dogs have never cried or whined once at the vet, and I think it’s because of how great their team is. Everyone is so patient and kind with our dogs. I also really appreciate how communicative and responsive they are. I know I can always get a quick question answered or be able to book a short-notice appointment

The doctors & vet techs at Blvd are amazing! Each visit has been prompt, clear and informative, with kind and gentle care for my cat. It is a relief to have such a reliable, helpful vet, and to know I won’t be upsold for unnecessary treatments.
First visit to this vet.  Great attitude about caring  for my older dog with practical and co.oassionate care.

Reception isn’t always the friendliest but all the staff working with my fur baby is top notch, with every visit!
UPDATE: since writing my initial review two years ago, things have changed with my experience with BLVD. It seems the have a higher than expected turnover rate--or at least I don't seem to see the same workers more than once (outside of the front desk staff). Their communication is awful and they seem to either lack the insight and awareness that their communication is awful or they don't care, as they don't own up to the fact that it is the customer that needs to follow-up with them, since they don't seem to respond to emails or voicemails. They also seem to only have one vet who can respond to situations, which is curious with the number of locations they have. With the most recent situation with them, I followed-up three times in four days, as they never once replied to the concern. Each person seemed to have a different response as to why and none took responsibility. What they did have in common was throwing the vet under the bus for being gone, being at lunch  or being too busy to respond. Though they are conveniently located for me, and most of my experiences have been positive, this most recent one has led to mistrust in their care, compassion or as they put it "Gold Standard."
Always easy to work with the vets here. I tend to ask a lot of questions and they always are able and willing to answer any questions or concerns I have. Attached picture of the two patients.

The entire staff at BLVD River North might love my pup more than I do!! They’re the best at helping to manage every step of his wellness journey, including hanging out with all of us on the floor if that’s what makes him feel more comfortable, and providing extra treat givers for nail trims. I feel so lucky to be a part of the BLVD family!

Blvd Vet is amazing and so good with my pup! They’re very helpful whenever I’ve called with a question, and everyone is so attentive with Polee, especially when he’s anxious. We’re very happy with Blvd Vet!
Lovely staff, great environment, feel like my pup is in safe hands!

We recently moved to Chicago in July and chose BLVD because it was so close!

We’ve taken our cats here multiple times for checkups, emergencies visits when they sick, and most recently a dental cleaning and extraction surgery. Every time we are impressed with the care our kitties receive, the clear communication from the front desk, techs and vets and transparency around billing.
Excellent. You feel welcome from the moment Bree meets you and the medical attention from Dr. Newman, Jorge and Daisy was terrific. Highly recommend.

Having moved to a new city and needing to find a new vet could have been stressful, but BLVD made the process so easy.  Their staff is unbelievably kind and very knowledgeable.  The facility is immaculate and the welcome bag and certificate of bravery were icing on the cake.  Will definitely continue using them.
Caring and excellent veterinarians with sensible advice, knowledgeable and kind Vet Techs, appointments are taken on time. My Shi-Poos puppies are not afraid to be there. They feel the love!

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating Tasha! We truly appreciate you taking the time to support our team. It means a lot to us, and we’re grateful for the trust you place in BLVD Vet. We look forward to caring for you and your pet again soon! 🐾

Sincerely,
Juli
Practice Manager

About a year ago I gave this place a try and I deeply regretted it. I came back to edit this review after finding better places because the fact that I still remember this sour experience should tell you a lot about this establishment. I often receive apologies from businesses recognizing honest mistakes and I amend my reviews accordingly, but the fact that I never received a real follow up from BLVD speaks for itself. And no Julie, responding very publicly to a review and expect me to reach out to you yet again is not the way to go. It is actually unbelievable that once again you proved my point because my partner was told a completely different story about how your “lab samples” are tested and where the day he dropped the sample.

I scheduled the initial exam appointment with our cat, but because my partner was the one to be there due to our availability you then used every opportunity to try to charge us more and more money. We paid over $200 for the exam. At the end of it my partner was specifically told that he was being charged for a $68 poop sample exam that had not been scheduled yet. When I later called to schedule it, I am told by another person that we have to pay $68 again if we want to get an appointment. So we ended up paying $68 twice. For no reason other than carelessness, miscommunication and inefficiency from their staff. Additionally, it turned out that the “exam fees” we paid for actually went to a machine—a machine that sits in a corner of their office with the sole purpose of analyzing poop. But regardless of whether this was simply a communication issue or not, no member of your team ever did anything to try to solve it with either one of us. I hope you start caring about your clients as much as you care about your reputation and money. It’s very clear what you care more about.

If you feel like $68 is a good price to have a snotty zoomer grab a container of poop from you and place it inside a machine then this is the place for you! I’m sure plenty of people appreciate how hard they work! (The machines)

I wish I could give zero stars. I booked an appointment for my senior dog to get vaccines up to date and to discuss his arthritis, which worsened since his last vet visit. At our visit, the vet took my dog to another room for his vaccines then tried to muzzle him. The vet brought my dog back into the room and explained that he growled at them. I apologized and asked if we could do vaccines in the room together as that is what we're all used to at his old vet. The vet refused and told me to bring him back on trazodone. Even though this has never been requested of me in the 11 years I've had my dog, I agreed and rescheduled an appointment, prepaying $199 for bloodwork and other testing including a urine test. On the day of my dog's next appointment, I gave him the trazodone, collected his urine, and stored it in my fridge. The vet then called me and cancelled his appointment just two hours prior because a vet had to do the exam, not just a vet tech (although I was under the impression he would see a vet as the exam was comprehensive and quoted to me at $700+ when I had already paid $275 for the initial visit). When I asked if I could just bring his urine sample, the vet refused and told me to throw out the one I collected even though I prepaid. My partner called the vet and asked what we should do about the upcoming urine test as we used our sample collection kit. The vet offered to get the sample through a needle poke and offered $25 off the service. However, since the service was double that
price, my partner asked for it to be comped. The woman on the phone consulted with her supervisor and approved the discount. The next day, the vet called my partner back revoking the discount entirely. There wasn't much of a reason given other than the fee has to go to ultrasound equipment, even though the woman on the phone agreed that the vet owns their ultrasound equipment and that my dog was not scheduled for an ultrasound. Will be finding another vet because this has been an awful experience.

Entire staff was very friendly and patient with my two anxious cats! Dr. Wilde and Jorge (sp?) took the time to thoroughly examine both of them and recommend after care treatment. Will definitely go back!

Hello Daisy,
We’re sorry to see your one-star review. I see from our recent notes that we had to decline a medication request for your pet. I know how frustrating it is when your pet is suffering, and you want to help them, and regret that you had a frustrating experience. 
Our goal is always to provide safe, high-quality care, and that includes following medical and legal guidelines when it comes to prescribing medications.

Most medications come with potential side effects and risks, and to prescribe them without a recent exam to assess the issue would be medically negligent. This is especially important for pets as they are not able to communicate symptoms and reactions that their owners might not be aware of, so we lean heavily on veterinary exams to ensure there isn't more going on than meets the eye. These policies are in place to protect pets and ensure appropriate treatment.

While we cannot discuss the specific concerns about your request on a public forum,  I would be more than happy to address them with you directly. Please feel free to contact our team so we can help clarify and support you however possible.

Best,
Juli
Practice Manager

Hello Jose,
The Boulevard Veterinary River North team is committed to providing compassionate care for pets and their families, and we are disappointed to hear that we did not meet your expectations. We are always striving to grow and adapt to meet the unique needs of our clients and patients, and as such, client feedback is incredibly valuable to us. Unfortunately, we’re unable to locate you in our system to try to assess what your concerns were, so we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you directly to better understand your concerns and address them appropriately. 
Best,
Juli
Practice Manager

Had such an amazing and helpful experience at Boulevard Vet River North! Our rescue dog was having emergency health issues and we brought him in as a first time client. Boulevard was able to see us within the same day and get him fully treated and back to health. The entire team was so helpful, kind, and understanding from start to finish. Very transparent about pricing, what care was being provided, and the cost options. Highly recommended! Thank you so much to the Boulevard team for being so accommodating and supportive!
Feel very inclined to review BLVD because Dr. Courville is just incredible. We have a senior pup and she spent plenty of time with us and was so patient in answering all of our questions.

Would not recommend BLVD. I was a customer for many years, and the veterinarians routinely missed issues with my dog, including a cancer diagnosis when they performed an aspiration improperly. This delayed critical care for a significant period of time. When they missed things, they would require full re-examination and were completely inflexible on charges, even though it was their negligence to blame. Not to mention their prices are higher than other vets. There are better options out there.

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Dr. Courville & her team. From our very first visit with Dr. Courville she has always shown an incredible depth of knowledge and genuine compassion. She always takes the time to thoroughly explain everything, making sure I feel informed and supported every step of the way. But what truly sets her apart is the way she always makes my pets feel truly important and valued—just as much as my pets are to me. Bonus that the clinic itself is adorable, with a warm and welcoming atmosphere too. Highly recommend.

We truly appreciate your rating Cynthia! Thank you for trusting us with your pet’s care — we’re so glad to have you in our community!

Best Wishes,
Juli
Practice Manager

Amazing clinic with super compassionate and empathetic staff. Someone stole my cat, and we came in to search. The staff was ridiculously helpful, supportive,  and went above and beyond to help! They also loved on our pups and gave them treats for Halloween.  From the bottom of my heart,  thank you all so much!! We love yall!!!

We absolutely adore everyone at BLVD! From the doctors, techs, and front desk staff, we have had exceptional service and care every single visit. I trust BLVD 100% with the care of my pet and know that anytime we are there, we are both in the best hands. I tell everyone I know that they need to go to BLVD for their pets care. Thanks BLVD for creating an amazing and safe space for all the pets and their humans!
Easy to stay in touch, friendly and patient doctors and staff - these make for a great experience for us as well as our puppy, Benji.
A lovely place to take your pet for all their medical needs. BLVD Vet cares about your little critter as much as you do. Fantastic care and very attentive staff. Glad I found them.

We’re so grateful for your 5-star rating! At BLVD River North we love helping pets stay happy and healthy through every stage of life. Thank you for trusting our team with your pet’s care!

Warmly,
Juli
Practice Manager

Your 5-star feedback means the world to us! Our team at BLVD Vet River North is committed to delivering personalized, compassionate veterinary care in a welcoming environment. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!

Warmly,
Juli
Practice Manager

Did not like this place and looking for a new vet already after our first visit. All we were for was to establish care and get some routine cat vaccines.

The vet’s demeanor felt condescending and overall mean/unfriendly from the moment she walked in. This was never my experience with our vets in MI. Immediately, I felt them pressure for unnecessary testing and diagnostics along with unnecessary vaccines given that I have an indoor cat. All of which have pretty wild pricing at times.

Their customer service is questionable, moving my appt time 6 hours prior when I’ve had that appt set for weeks. They take your pet to another room to do anything to them which I’ve never had happen - I’ve always been able to comfort my pet and see what they’re doing to them/how they treat them.

Wouldn’t recommend and not comfortable returning.

The clinic seems to care more about money than about pets. I feel pressured to accept as many non-core vaccines as possible, and I was told that if I don’t, my dog will get sick. On top of that, I was advised to give my dog 5 vaccines at the same time, which I don’t believe is necessary. I’m not sure if I want to come back to this place

Thank you so much for your 5-star rating Morgan! We’re thrilled to know you had a positive experience with our team at BLVD Vet River North. Our doctors and staff are committed to providing compassionate, high-quality veterinary care for pets throughout Chicago. We appreciate your trust and look forward to seeing you and your pet family at future visits!

Sincerely,
Juli
Practice Manager

We love how kind and thorough the staff and Drs are here. We would recommend BLVD to anybody with a pet. We don't even live in the neighborhood anymore but still drive to go see the wonderful Drs there.

I have greatly appreciated the care and support given to help me take care of Lucy. The Doctors and Staff have shown they are warm and caring and have made us feel right at home. In addition, the recommendation for Lucy to see an Internal Medicine Specialist was very necessary and helpful.

We are so thankful to have become clients of BLVD Veterinary and will definitely recommend this practice to others.  Happy Thanksgiving!

Update......

We received wonderful care for Lucy and Dr. Newman was most responsive to my concerns. I greatly appreciate Dr. Newman's follow up call too!  So glad to have BLVD nearby!

Update.....

I was very pleased and grateful for Lucy's care provided by Dr. Boisture, Emily and Evalise. Lucy has made a great recovery and she is back to her rascally self!

Update.....

We were grateful for Dr. Blanchard's care and Veterinary Technician Nicole's assistance in helping Lucy feel better. The diagnostic tests were very helpful and their good results provided "peace of mind". The Saturday hours were a wonderful convenience since we could get help for Lucy right away. Thank you so much!

Update.....

An outstanding office visit experience with Dr. Newman and her assistant, Jo. I brought my Siamese Kitty, Lucy, in for a "post ER" visit and Dr. Newman provided me with "peace of mind" with her knowledge, expertise and care for Lucy.

I would really like to see a "BLVD Cat" practice at this location, but I understand this is driven by market demographics and a business case.

Thank you again for your care for Lucy!
Consistently have a wonderful experience here. ALL the staff is so kind, professional and compassionate during every visit.

I’ve been to this location a few times since moving to River North, and I have to say, the service leaves a lot to be desired. For one, I find that this locations gears itself much more towards dogs, as opposed to cats. The last time I was in, the veterinarian openly stated that they do not see very many cats, and i felt that it showed in how they handled my cat. I also felt that the veterinarian tacked on multiple costly procedures, without explaining what these procedure were for, or how they would benefit my cat. The other aspect of the buisness I just simply did not appreciate, was how rude some of the staff members were. I totally understand that dealing with people all day can be exhausting, though I don’t want to feel antagonized for simply wanting to understand what is going on with my cat. If you are a cat owner and in the area, I would suggest trying to find a different provider, especially for what the cost is.

My dog can be an anxious handful, and both the vet and tech were very patient with her, making her feel as comfortable as she could have been. Both were flexible and asked for my input about the best way to handle her anxiety during the exam. It’s always relieving to find people who care! Plus, having Saturday hours available was super helpful for me. I’d highly recommend!
Always handle with care, and great service.

Hello Jeri,
I am so sorry to see that we did not meet your expectations. I would love to connect so I can better understand where we missed the mark. If you are willing to discuss further, please call (312-888-3630) or e-mail (rivernorth@blvd.vet), and we can set up a time to talk.
Best,
Juli
Practice Manager

I can’t recommend enough. When we first moved here, I was worried about my pup and booked an appointment. Rather than just putting me on the schedule and charging for visit fees, they called to follow up for clarification and then were able to immediately give me information on what would need to be presenting to raise concern. I was able to feel less anxious and save on unnecessary appointment fees. We of course went back to establish care later on and I’m so grateful we have—this team is amazing.

We now have another dog who has been a bit of a frequent flyer. The staff here has been so patient, so empathetic, and just so helpful throughout this whole thing. I have never had a veterinary team so patiently walk us through options while navigating veterinary care. It is so hard to get care for pets when they aren’t able to communicate for themselves, but this clinic staff truly does make us feel like our concerns are being heard and our pets are being cared for
Our experience with everyone at this location has been exemplary each time!

Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! At BLVD Vet River North, we’re passionate about providing exceptional veterinary care for the pets and people of Chicago’s River North community. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon! - BLVD Vet River North

Thank you for your fantastic 5-star review! At BLVD Vet River North, we’re proud to offer compassionate, personalized care to pets and their families throughout the Chicago community. 

Your trust in our veterinary team means everything to us, and we’re grateful to be part of your pet’s healthcare journey. We look forward to continuing to provide outstanding care during every visit!

I'm not sure how I feel about this place. I started going here a few times since I moved from the west coast to Chicago. (1) Their costs as a chain are double what the local vet I used to go to charges. (2) Opaque pricing -they would often throw medicine without telling me the cost. My old vet was upfront, saying this would cost x and y, it is up to you if you want to do it. BLVD vet made it seem like it's not optional. Shady billing practices. (3) Availability -oftentimes I was unable to reach the desk by phone and brought straight to voice mail. My last vet had a phone queue so at least you had a chance of talking to someone if you were willing to wait. One time I was unable to reach for several days, so I ended up taking my cat to the Emergency vet instead. Strangely, the emergency vet and BLVD vet have similar pricing. I might as well go to the emergency vet instead of it's going to cost the same and I get better bedside manner. (4) Poor bedside manner, it seems like the staff are very unhappy to work there. Overall, I would rate this place average and give it three stars since it's close to my apartment.

Thank you for the 5-star rating! We’re so glad to hear you’ve had a great experience at BLVD Vet River North. 

Our dedicated team works hard to provide top-quality veterinary care with compassion and integrity for every pet we see. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you and your pet back to our River North clinic soon!

Thank you for your wonderful 5-star rating! BLVD Vet River North is committed to providing outstanding care for pets and the people who love them. 

We’re proud to serve the River North neighborhood with trusted veterinary services focused on your pet’s health and happiness. We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you again soon!

Thank you for your kind 5-star review! Our team at BLVD Vet River North is passionate about offering the highest standard of care to pets in the heart of Chicago. 

Your feedback encourages us to continue providing compassionate, thorough veterinary services to every pet we see. We’re grateful to have you as part of our BLVD Vet family!

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! At BLVD Vet River North, we’re dedicated to delivering compassionate, high-quality veterinary care to pets throughout the Chicago community. 

We’re so glad to hear you had a positive experience and appreciate your trust in our team. We look forward to continuing to care for your pet!

We have been going to Boulevard for almost 3 years now with our two cats, and they have been nothing but wonderful. Our oldest cat is 18, and the quality of care they provide is more than top notch. Every single vet here gives it their all, and the other staff is wonderful. Their care is incredibly personalized. We’ve had our ups and downs with her health, and they’ve been there every step of the way.

Thank you for the 5-star review! We’re so happy to hear you had a positive experience at BLVD Vet River North. Our team is dedicated to providing exceptional veterinary care and building lasting relationships with our clients and their pets. We appreciate your trust and look forward to seeing you both again soon!

Thank you for your fantastic 5-star feedback! At BLVD Vet River North, we know how important it is to find a veterinary team you can trust. We're honored to provide compassionate, high-quality care for pets throughout Chicago’s River North community. Thank you for choosing us!

My dog had a foot injury and this vet took her same day. My dog is extremely timid and scared of most people. The ENTIRE staff was so kind and slow with her she definitely felt more at ease. They were informative and not pushy at all. I will be making this my full time vet now that I’ve had such a great experience:)
Always take such good care of our boys. Very friendly and caring. Definitely recommend!

Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! We’re proud to serve the pets of BLVD Vet River North with top-notch veterinary care in a warm, welcoming environment. Your support means the world to our team, and we’re grateful for the opportunity to care for your beloved companion.
We love Boulevard Vet! The entire team is great!

We truly appreciate your 5-star review! At BLVD Vet River North, our mission is to provide personalized, compassionate care to every pet who visits us. Thank you for trusting our team with your pet’s health and for being part of our BLVD Vet family.

BLVD Vet has always been so great to Simba. Moving to a new city and establishing care for our furry one can be intimidating but BLVD vet has always treated us like they have known us for years! Thank you!
BLVD Vet River North is always super-responsive, and my dog feels incredibly comfortable with all of their providers.

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star review! We’re honored to care for pets in the River North neighborhood and strive to make every visit a positive experience. Your kind words help us continue delivering the highest standard of veterinary care in Chicago.

The entire team at Blvd River North is wonderful! We have seen a few doctors and we've always gotten quality service and care. Dr. Boisture has seen both of our dogs several times and always takes the time to talk with us, interpret test results and put us at ease. So happy to have Blvd right down the street!
The technician was especially charming and good with Angel.  The Doctor was very pleasant and knowledgeable.  The office staff is great, too.  I really enjoy the care that is taken there.  Thank you.

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review! We’re honored to care for pets in the River North neighborhood and strive to make every visit a positive experience. Your rating helps us continue delivering the highest standard of veterinary care in Chicago.

We truly appreciate your 5-star review! At BLVD Vet River North, our mission is to provide personalized, compassionate care to every pet who visits us. Thank you for trusting our team with your pet’s health and for being part of our BLVD Vet family.
Everyone, EVERYONE, is so sweet, patient and friendly here. I always feel comforted, my questions are answered, and my cats are treated like celebrities here. They set the bar sky high here!!!
